intervals.label: phase I data taking
intervals.note: Year precision. The paper says the spectrometer 'yielded first results in 1991' (so data taking began no later than 1991) and shows 'the last spectrum from phase I taken in 1994' (section 4, Fig. 20 caption); the phase I start month and the exact end are not stated.
intervals.quote: Our spectrometer yielded first results in 1991

intervals.label: phase II improvement programme (new frozen-T2 source, flow cryostat, background reduction)
intervals.note: Year precision, from the final-results paper: 'Phase II of the Mainz neutrino mass experiment started in 1995 with substantial improvements'; data at the improved signal-to-background ratio 'from 1997 on'.
intervals.quote: we performed in the years 1995-97 a substantial improvement program

intervals.label: phase II data taking
intervals.note: Year precision. Section 7 of the paper says the data taking on the neutrino mass covered 1998 to 2001 (the first improved runs, 1997, are counted in the abstract); phase III (background studies for KATRIN) was running when the paper was written (2004) and is not a neutrino-mass data-taking interval.
intervals.quote: Extensive data taking took place in the years 1997 to 2001.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Terminal event: end of neutrino-mass data taking in 2001 (year precision). The paper (2004) says the spectrometer was then in 'the presently running phase III ... to prepare the followup experiment KATRIN', a background-reduction programme, not a neutrino-mass search; no source gives the end of phase III.
intervals.quote: Extensive data taking took place in the years 1997 to 2001.

name: Mainz MAC-E-filter spectrometer with frozen tritium source

placements.note: Placed at the campus-grade Institute of Physics point; the paper gives the affiliation only, not the hall.
placements.quote: Institut für Physik der Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz, D-55099 Mainz, Germany

diameter.quote: the diameter of the spectrometer vessel is 1 m

isotope.quote: The paper reports on the improved Mainz experiment on tritum β spectroscopy

length.note: Distance between the source and the detector, not the vessel length.
length.quote: The distance between source and detector is about 6 m

description.quote: Frozen T2 source housed in the tilted solenoid S1; guiding solenoids S2, S3; the vessel with altogether 27 electrodes
description.value: Frozen T2 source in a tilted solenoid, guiding solenoids, a vessel with 27 electrodes and a refocussing solenoid housing the detector

subsystems.name: Frozen T2 source and MAC-E filter

summary.plain: The Mainz spectrometer: a six-metre-long vacuum vessel with strong magnets and electrodes that lets only the highest-energy electrons from decaying tritium (frozen in a thin film) through to a detector.
summary.technical: MAC-E filter: frozen molecular-tritium film source in a solenoid, 27-electrode spectrometer vessel of 1 m diameter, source-to-detector distance about 6 m, electron detector in a refocussing solenoid.

technology.quote: thereafter electrostatic filters with magnetic adiabatic collimation (MAC-E-Filters) took over
technology.value: Electrostatic filter with magnetic adiabatic collimation (MAC-E filter) analysing the beta spectrum of a quench-condensed molecular-tritium film
